statement: Pinned SDL exposes 15 buttons and six gamepad axes for Wii U Pro: four calibrated analog stick axes plus two digital ZL/ZR trigger axes; its Pro button decoder uses active-low button bits and its own stick normalization/deadzone model.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL gamepad state mapping, not a guarantee of every launcher or SDL version.
